decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures that displayed commissions must include randomly allocated no-referral commissions for primary mints and exclude secondary-market sales.
The same-message RESUME already resolves the no-referral ticket ambiguity, while the retained recipient-selection rule already requires random allocation to an existing NFT holder.
The source and supporting context concern dashboard and leaderboard accounting totals, not NFT metadata attributes or counters.
The source changes commission and ticket reconciliation, not which successfully minted NFTs appear in a user's dashboard inventory.
Commission and ticket totals are not referral counts; randomly allocated no-referral rewards do not necessarily create recorded referrals.
The source requires commission and ticket totals to reconcile with primary mints but does not change public referral-count statistics.
Excluding secondary-market sales from commission and ticket issuance does not change the existing public countdown for the next prize draw.
Commission and ticket accounting does not affect NFT image or media rendering behavior.
The source addresses commission and ticket counts, not prize-pool funding or displayed pool balances.
The current FAQ already states that no-referral mints randomly allocate commissions and Small Block tickets, and the source does not request a copy change.
The public mint-count rule already counts successfully completed mints, and the source does not modify how public mint statistics are calculated.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records one Small Block ticket per primary mint and exclusion of secondary-market sales.
